mapper.sql: select channel_id, record_id, route_code, channel_name, provider, corp_id, agent_id, to_user, secret_cipher, status, claim_token, attempt_count, error_message, wecom_msg_id, last_attempt_time, create_time, update_time from notification_record_channel
mapper.insert:
insert into notification_record_channel (record_id, route_code, channel_name, provider, corp_id, agent_id, to_user, secret_cipher, status, attempt_count, create_time, update_time) values
(#{channel.recordId}, #{channel.routeCode}, #{channel.channelName}, #{channel.provider}, #{channel.corpId}, #{channel.agentId}, #{channel.toUser}, #{channel.secretCipher}, #{channel.status}, 0, #{channel.createTime}, #{channel.updateTime})
mapper.select: select c.channel_id from notification_record_channel c join notification_record r on r.record_id = c.record_id where c.status = 'PENDING' and r.deleted = '0' and r.revoked = '0' order by c.channel_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update notification_record_channel set status = 'SENDING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where channel_id = #{channelId} and status = 'PENDING'
update notification_record_channel set status = 'FAILED', claim_token = null, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{now} where status = 'SENDING'
update notification_record_channel set status = 'FAILED', claim_token = null, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{now} where record_id = #{recordId} and status = 'SENDING'
mapper.select: select distinct record_id from notification_record_channel where status = #{status}

select coalesce(sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedCount from notification_record_channel where record_id = #{recordId}
